title: Event Handling Best Practices & Performance
description: Tips for writing clean, efficient, and maintainable event handlers.

slides.title: Keep Templates Clean
slides.content:
# Best Practice: Keep Logic in Methods

Avoid writing complex JavaScript inside your template. Use methods instead.

**❌ Bad:**
```html
<button @click="items.push({ id: Date.now(), text: newItem }); newItem = ''">Add</button>
```

**✅ Good:**
```html
<button @click="addItem">Add</button>
```

Your template should focus on structure, not logic.

quizData.question: Why should you avoid writing complex JavaScript inside a template event handler?

options.text: It makes the template harder to read and maintain

quizData.explanation: Keeping templates declarative and moving logic to methods improves readability, testability, and maintainability.
